newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market seen quiet.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market seen quiet.

text.p: Swiss money market activity was quiet, with traders waiting for release of U.S. nonfarm payrolls on Friday before drawing any conclusions about the market's direction.
U.S. payrolls could set the near-term tone for the dollar. Weakness in dollar/Swiss has recently tended to put upward pressure on short-term Swiss rates.

Traders said the Swiss National Bank was seen adding liquidity at market prices. But one trader said its actions were mainly to "show its presence" in the market. Tomorrow/next money was quoted by one bank at 1-7/8 to 2.00 percent.
